2795.title: Scoped thread creation replaces a focused split pane
2795.rootCauseOneLine: The scoped create handler navigates directly to composer content, so route reconciliation replaces the focused pane.
2795.proposedFix: Select a scoped-create policy, then use the existing split helper while preserving route state and compact behavior.
2795.caveats: The project button was reproduced directly twice. Section buttons share the same handler by trusted source inspection. The cap size and modifier policy need product review.
